summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO 55001 Lead Implementer exam with five days of AMS implementation, performance evaluation, and audit preparation training.
audienceIntro: ISO 55001 Lead Implementer training suits professionals responsible for designing, coordinating, implementing, or evaluating an asset management system. It is most relevant if you already have a fundamental understanding of asset management concepts and principles.
prerequisites: To attend this training course, you should have a fundamental understanding of asset management concepts and principles. Passing the exam does not by itself grant the PECB Certified ISO 55001 Lead Implementer credential. PECB’s Lead Implementer requirements, subject to PECB's published certification scheme requirements at time of application, include five years of professional experience, two years of work experience in asset management, 300 hours of AMS project activities, and signing the PECB Code of Ethics.
